summarization:
This smartphone UI screen allows users to quickly switch between different accounts. The screen displays a list of accounts with associated names and email addresses. The current account is shown at the top, with additional accounts listed below. Each account entry has a profile picture and an "X" button, likely for removing the account from the list. 

At the bottom of the screen, there is a message indicating that the user is unauthorized to access a certain feature or content, possibly due to lack of permissions or because the course has not started yet. 

Navigation options include a "SKIP" button on the left and a right arrow on the right, suggesting the ability to move forward in the setup or tutorial process. There are also three dots in the center, indicating the presence of multiple screens or steps in the process.
